pirs.statement: Will Lagrådet issue a constitutional opinion finding prop. 2025/26:258 non-compliant with RF Chapter 2 (freedom of association)?
pirs.trigger: Lagrådet opinion publication at www.lagradet.se mentioning proportionalitet or föreningsfrihet in context of prop. 2025/26:258
pirs.answer_summary: Lagrådet opinion not reviewed for this analysis run. This PIR remains open and is the single highest-value intelligence gap.

pirs.statement: Will KU committee vote to adopt, amend, or reject prop. 2025/26:258?
pirs.trigger: KU committee report (betänkande) published by riksdagen.se
pirs.answer_summary: KU has a Tidö majority (~9-10 of 17 seats). We assess with HIGH confidence KU will recommend adoption. A minority report (reservationsyttrande) from S, C, and V/MP is highly probable.

pirs.statement: Will LO announce preemptive restructuring of collective party membership contributions for compliance with prop. 2025/26:258?
pirs.trigger: LO press release or congress decision on political contribution restructuring
pirs.answer_summary: LO has strong incentive to maintain S support through any mechanism. Preemptive restructuring (rather than fighting the law) has historically been LO's pragmatic approach. Probability assessed at ~30% before election.

pirs.statement: Will C (Centerpartiet) maintain its constitutional opposition to prop. 2025/26:258 through the September 2026 election campaign?
pirs.trigger: C public statement or party platform release endorsing or withdrawing the HD024184 constitutional argument
pirs.answer_summary: C has strategic interest in maintaining this position as a coalition signal. No contrary indicators observed. PIR status: LIKELY C holds its position.
